home.heroLead: The roller skating rink in the heart of Brussels.
home.tributeBody: Rollerland Brussels carries on the legacy of Rollerland Aalst, a Belgian roller skating institution. An official presentation text will soon enrich this section.
home.ctaLead: Book online or by email at {email}. Quick reply guaranteed.

tarifs.title: Prices
tarifs.intro: All prices are per person. Reservation required for groups. Skates included in all group packages.
tarifs.optionsNote: Free protective gear if you bring your own skates. Skates included in all group packages.
tarifs.consume1: Please consume locally and support Be Here.
tarifs.consume2: Refrain from bringing your own food and drinks.

formule.consume2: Refrain from bringing your own food and drinks.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: For any reservation, information or question. Reply within 24h by email.
contact.emailDesc: For reservations, group quotes and any question. Quick reply guaranteed.
contact.socialsDesc: Follow our events, schedule and disco nights.
contact.reviewDesc: Enjoyed your visit? Leave us a review, it helps us a lot.

reservation.caption: Reply within 24h · You can also write to us at {email}

cours.title: Roller Lessons
cours.intro: Learn to skate or improve your technique with our certified instructors. Skates included — just bring your desire to glide.
cours.start2rideDesc: Outdoor training at Parc de Laeken. Practice roller skating in a natural setting with our instructors. Ideal to progress outside the indoor rink.
cours.ownSkatesText: Bringing your own skates? Protective gear is free. No extra charge.
cours.cancellationsText: Join the lessons WhatsApp group to be informed in real time of cancellations or schedule changes.
cours.whatsappSoon: Group link available soon — request it by email at {email}.

pratique.title: Practical info
pratique.intro: Everything you need to know before coming to Rollerland Brussels.
pratique.parkingText: Secure parking available at number 160. Book your spot online via ParkBee.

privateEvents.title: Private Events
privateEvents.intro: From disco nights to team building and birthdays — Rollerland Brussels adapts to all your private event projects.
privateEvents.privatizationTitle: Privatize the rink for your event
privateEvents.privatizationText: The rink is available for privatization for large groups and corporate events.

horaires.title: Schedule
horaires.intro: Outside regular hours, the rink is available by reservation for school groups, team buildings and birthdays.
horaires.updatesText: Follow us on social media so you never miss a cancellation, a schedule change or a special event.

disco.lead: Music, strobe lights and a rink open until midnight. Every week, a new musical theme.
disco.weeklyUpdate: Programme updated every week · Entry always free
